desc1: Sneaky Links goes far beyond traditional dating apps — it's a full social platform where users connect based on shared interests, share photos and videos on a live timeline, run monetized community rooms, and go incognito via Sneaky Mode. descItems.title: The Story
descItems.desc: Sneaky Links was built for people who want genuine freedom in how they connect online — no judgment, no exposure unless you choose it, and a platform that adapts to who you want to be at any given moment. The core innovation is Sneaky Mode: a fully separate incognito profile that only surfaces to users who share your interests and are actively online at the same time. When you leave, everything disappears. This ephemeral, interest-matched design creates a uniquely safe yet spontaneous experience that traditional social and dating apps can't offer. Paired with community rooms, live streaming for millions, and a digital coin economy, Sneaky Links has grown to over 115K active users with a 4.9-star rating.

descItems.title: Our Approach
descItems.desc: The app is built entirely in Flutter for a single-codebase iOS and Android experience. The backend runs on Node.js and Python microservices handling user management, real-time events, ephemeral content lifecycle (Sneaky Mode post expiry), room management, and the Sneaky Coins wallet and transaction system. React.js and Next.js power the web presence and admin interfaces. OpenAI is used for interest-based user matching, smart content suggestions, and automated moderation to keep the platform safe. MongoDB's flexible document model is ideal for the platform's varied data types — user profiles, timeline posts, live room states, coin transactions, and ephemeral Sneaky Mode content. The live streaming architecture supports up to 20 simultaneous on-stage participants and broadcast to millions of viewers in real time.

featuredDesc: DOMEZ — the fastest booking application for indoor and outdoor sports — needed a product design that matched its ambition: zero friction from discovery to court. The project delivered a sleek, intuitive mobile app where players find facilities, book instantly, and split the bill with teammates in seconds.
dataFilter: sports booking consumer mobile payments lifestyle innovate

descItems.title: The Story
descItems.desc: For sports enthusiasts, booking a dome or court has always been unnecessarily complicated — calling venues one by one, hoping a slot is free, then chasing teammates for their share of the payment. DOMEZ was built to fix exactly that. As a platform solely focused on sports facilities, DOMEZ understands the specific needs of pitches, courts, halls, and playing surfaces better than any general-purpose booking tool. The result is an app that lets players search their city's facilities instantly, view real-time availability and pricing, book in seconds, and split the cost equally among all players — with no awkward money conversations after the game. For facility owners, DOMEZ provides a complete suite of tools to manage bookings, payments, and listings, all from a single platform.

descItems.title: Our Approach
descItems.desc: The design was built Figma-first — establishing a sport-forward visual language that feels energetic, clean, and effortless to navigate. Every screen was designed with the player's journey at its core: from landing on the app and discovering nearby facilities, to selecting a time slot, choosing how to pay (full or split), and confirming a booking in just a few taps. The split-payment flow received special design attention — it needed to be completely frictionless, mathematically transparent, and accessible to all players in a group booking simultaneously. League discovery and registration flows were designed to surface upcoming leagues prominently so competitive players never miss a registration window. The facility owner dashboard was crafted separately as a management-first interface, prioritising booking visibility, availability control, and payment tracking.

descItems.title: The Story
descItems.desc: Equito was built around a bold mission — to make real estate investment accessible to everyone, not just the wealthy. Traditionally, buying property requires significant capital, legal expertise, and ongoing management. Equito strips all of that away by tokenizing properties and allowing anyone to buy fractional ownership from just €100. Based in Barcelona, the platform focuses on exclusive Spanish real estate, handling all due diligence, legal structuring, and property management on behalf of investors. Users simply choose properties they believe in, invest what they can afford, and receive monthly rental income directly in the app — making real estate as simple as a stock trade. Today, Equito has 225,000+ registered investors and plans to invest €30M+ in over 122 homes.

descItems.title: Our Approach
descItems.desc: The mobile app is built in Flutter for a seamless, consistent experience across iOS and Android. The backend runs on Node.js and Python microservices handling property tokenization, investment processing, KYC/identity verification, monthly rental income distribution, and portfolio analytics. React.js and Next.js power the web platform and investor dashboard. OpenAI provides intelligent property recommendations based on each investor's portfolio, risk tolerance, and preferences — as well as onboarding assistance and automated investor Q&A. MongoDB serves as the primary data store for all user accounts, property tokens, investment records, and rental distribution history. The architecture is designed to scale to thousands of concurrent property listings and hundreds of thousands of investors across multiple markets.
